title: T033 reusable provider, observer, stimulation-tool, and gateway contract suites

scope.intended_use: Implement the capability-007 reusable provider, observer, stimulation-tool, and gateway contract suites: four implementation-agnostic conformance drivers behind narrow subject seams, instantiated against the accepted implementations with additive t033-<kind> tests, proving a reusable provider/observer/stimulation-tool/gateway conformance boundary without adding a second provider or changing any accepted production source.
boundaries: Bounded capability-007 prototype scope: five reusable contract-suite test-support headers and four additive test drivers.

No production runtime source change, no second synthetic provider, no TCP listener, AF_INET/AF_INET6 socket, DNS, resolver, TLS, external peer, legacy binary, production workload, compiled/linked gRPC runtime, or change to the accepted T030 contract, T031 gateway, or T032 client.

success_criteria: Every accepted T033 software requirement is traced to the applicable X-Verse system anchor, component, unit, code, unit/integration/validation tests and measured evidence.
The four additive t033-<kind> suites and the preserved platform suites pass in the offline admitted build.
Independent review and strict delivery validation bind the exact candidate before acceptance.
